title: Accounts Assistant
description:
I am working with a well-established organisation in Cambourne
who are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to support the
day-to-day transactional finance function. This role would suit
someone with previous finance experience who is looking to
develop their skills across both accounts payable and accounts
receivable.

Key responsibilities:

Processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate accounts
payable records
Managing customer invoices, receipts and outstanding balances
Assisting with payment runs and supplier statement
reconciliations
Processing employee expenses and ensuring supporting
documentation is complete
Performing bank and balance sheet reconciliations
Responding to supplier and customer queries in a professional
and timely manner
Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end
processes
Providing general transactional finance and administrative
support as required

The ideal candidate will have:

Previous experience in an accounts or finance position
Good understanding of transactional finance, ideally across
both AP and AR
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work
Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems
Clear communication skills and the ability to manage routine
queries effectively

This is a good opportunity for an Accounts Assistant seeking a
broad transactional finance role. If you have the relevant
experience and are interested in discussing the position, we
would be pleased to hear from you.

Please apply via the advert or contact John Falconer at Eclectic
Recruitment for more information.

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you
haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you
have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the
position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email
to discuss other potential opportunities.

title: CAMB - Client Services Coordinator
description:
Front of House & Facilities Coordinator

Salary: £28,000 pa

Location: Cambridge

Term: Permanent

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Front of House & Facilities Coordinator to join a professional and forward-thinking company based at Cambridge Science Park.

This is a varied role combining front of house, administration, customer service and facilities support. You will be a key point of contact for clients and visitors, helping to ensure the building runs smoothly and is always welcoming and well presented.

Candidates from a strong front-of-house background are very welcome to apply, particularly those who have worked within hotels, hospitality, serviced offices or other busy customer-facing environments.

Key Responsibilities for the Front of House & Facilities Coordinator role:
- Provide a professional and welcoming front-of-house service for clients and visitors.
- Manage incoming calls, post, deliveries and general enquiries.
- Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure rooms are prepared and presented to a high standard.
- Assist with the day-to-day running and presentation of reception, communal and kitchen areas.
- Liaise with contractors and suppliers regarding maintenance, cleaning and facilities issues.
- Provide basic first-line IT support and escalate issues where required.
- Keep CRM and booking systems accurate and up to date.
- Assist with parking, access cards, keys and general administration.
- Provide holiday and sickness cover when required.

Ideal Candidate for the Front of House & Facilities Coordinator role:
- Previous reception, front-of-house, administration or hospitality experience.
- Candidates from hotels and other customer-focused hospitality environments are encouraged to apply.
- A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle is essential.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Good Microsoft Office and general IT skills.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail.
- Confident working independently and using your own initiative.
- A proactive, hands-on and flexible approach.
- Smart and professional with a friendly and confident manner.

Package for the Front of House & Facilities Coordinator role:
- Salary £28,000 pa
- Monday to Friday, 8.30am - 5.00pm
- Permanent position

If you're looking for a varied Front of House & Facilities Coordinator role where you can use your front-of-house and customer service skills within a professional working environment, we'd be pleased to hear from you.
Apply today with your CV to be considered.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
Our client is an upmarket global real estate agency with anenviable reputationand an international network of offices. They are currently recruiting for an experienced Lettings Administrator to support their friendly team in Cambridge.

As the lettings administrator, your role will involve overseeing the day-to-day operations of the office, ensuring properties are marketed effectively and that clients and customers receive an exceptional level of service. This is a varied and fast-paced role, involving greeting walk-in clients and coordinating appointments and property listings.

To be considered you should have at least 1 years' experience within an administration role and superb attention to detail. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic lettings administrator with a can-do approach and who isn't afraid to get involved in lots of different projects. If this sounds like you, please get in touch today!

Personal specification:
- 1 years' lettings administration experience would be beneficial
- Experience within a fast paced administrative role
- Ideally be ARLA licensed/achieved the NFOPP Technical Award
- Excellent IT skills, including Excel, Power Point, Word, etc.
- Strong organisational skills
- Confident in dealing with clients.

The salary on offer for this lettings administrator role will be between £29,000 and £32,000 depending on experience, plus discretionary bonus. Benefits include 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, Christmas and New Year, pension, on-site gym, and more!

Working hours are Monday to Friday from 8.45am to 5.30pm.

title: Patent Administrator
company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Patent Administrator - Cambridge 12-Month FTC

Are you an experienced Patent IP Administrator. A fantastic opportunity has arisen to join a highly regarded professional services firm in their Cambridge office on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

The Role

You will provide essential administrative support within a busy IP team, helping to ensure patent and intellectual property matters are processed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing incoming correspondence and updating the IP case management system
- Generating and forwarding documentation to clients and external parties
- Electronic filing and document management
- Monitoring deadlines and reminder lists
- Liaising with external parties to resolve queries and obtain instructions
- Maintaining accurate case records and documentation
- Supporting case creation, case administration, filing and post-filing activities

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous administrative experience within a legal environment
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong IT skills, including MS Office and Outlook
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- The ability to manage deadlines and work under pressure
- A proactive and methodical approach

Experience within Intellectual Property, a document management system or the CIPA qualification would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The firm offers an excellent salary and benefits and hybrid working 60% remote.

Please get in touch with me for further information or to apply confidentially.

title: Receptionist
company: Cambridge University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Cambridge University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
description: In this role, you would contribute to the provision of a professional administration and Reception service for the Cardiology Diagnostic Department and all its users including patients, relatives and colleagues. You will plan and organise a range of straightforward tasks to set timescales, to ensure the provision of a professional clerical / administrative / secretarial service by as requested by managers and others, i.e. patients, relatives, colleagues and Trust Staff. Apply appropriate communication methods using a range of verbal and non-verbal skills effectively and professionally welcoming and treating everyone (patients, relatives, colleagues and Trust Staff) in a friendly and courteous manner presenting a good image of yourself through your attitude, behaviour and appearance. Produce work of the quality and quantity as required ensuring expected Trust and department standards and deadlines are met. Contribute to ensuring that the working environment is safe and of a professional appearance reporting any problems, organising repairs/collection of waste as appropriate and maintain efficient and effective use of resources. Work effectively and efficiently recommending better ways of working, sharing ideas with others to improve service delivery. Greet visitor's face-to face and respond to requests for basic information. Receive and respond to straight forward telephone call. Receive and respond to straightforward emails. Complete straightforward forms / administrating / correspondence using templates. Liaise with colleagues with issues outside your control. Ability to work on call to assist with Major Incidents. Book appointments and transport. Photocopy and filing. Retrieve case notes. Maintain stock levels and place orders. Collect, open and distribute mail. Input information on Trust systems. Cover other positions with work area during absence and any other administrative duties as required. Please see the attached Applicant Information Pack (combined Job Description and Person Specification) for key duties and responsibilities. Please note:- Internal applicants on permanent contracts can apply for this post as a secondment or fixed term contract. For secondments you must have the approval of your line manager before applying. If you are aninternal applicant currently on a fixed term contract you are able to apply for this as a fixed term position. All appointments with a start date on or after 1 October 2026 will be subject to a 12-week probationary period. This provides a structured and supportive period to help you settle into your role, with regular reviews and feedback. Right to Work As there is a 12-week probationary period, successful candidates are expected to have the Right to Work for a period of at least 6 months from the proposed start date. Immigration and Right to Work status will be discussed with successful candidates at conditional offer. CUH will not offer sponsorship to candidates that have applied for a fee waiver. As per Home Office guidelines, please be aware that, unfortunately, the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular position. The advert will close at midnight on 23rd September 2026. Interviews are due to be held on 8th October 2026. Please note that there will be a short test as part of the interview process. Benefits to you At Cambridge University Hospitals, we want to do all we can to support good working days. We offer development opportunities and a wide range of benefits, including on-site leisure facilities, shopping concourse and day nurseries. Our good work programme currently includes providing reduced cost Stagecoach bus travel to and from Cambridge University Hospital site. Park and Ride bus journeys between Babraham Road and Trumpington sites are free, as is the route to and from Cambridge train station and our hospitals. We also subsidise the cost of parking on site for eligible staff. On CUH campus, hot food is available 24/7 and at a reduced cost for colleagues. Recently we launched the first of our staff pod break spaces. Located in the Deakin Centre, we have a purpose-created colleague-only caf, with free tea and coffee, a break space and private outside area for colleagues to rest, refuel and recharge. Just one of the ways we are working hard to support good working days at CUH. CUH is committed to assisting employees in achieving a good work-life balance irrespective of role or personal circumstances. Flexible arrangements may include, but are not limited to, part-time working, job-share, term-time working and flexible start and finish times. Please note if you would like to discuss the required hours of this role further, you should approach the contact given. In some cases, alternative working hours will be considered. We welcome applications from the Armed Forces.

title: CRM Officer
description:
CRM Officer

Hybrid working 3 days onsite

A forward-thinking UK higher-education organisation is looking for a CRM Officer to join a collaborative marketing team and help deliver data-driven, insight-led CRM activity. This is a permanent role with hybrid working (approx. 60% campus-based)

You'll play a key part in planning and delivering CRM communications and campaigns, working across the full lifecycle from audience selection and data preparation through to testing, deployment, performance reporting and continuous optimisation.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting CRM programmes and end-to-end campaign delivery, including planning, testing and implementation
- Preparing and segmenting customer data for targeted marketing activity
- Delivering effective B2 C and B2 B digital CRM communications
- Using large datasets to analyse performance and identify actionable insights
- Building dashboards and reporting to measure and communicate KPIs, evaluate markets/products and drive decision-making
- Working within an agile team, including supporting the introduction of a new system and/or marketing strategy
- Handling complex queries with sound judgement, escalating risks appropriately, and delivering a high standard of customer service

What we're looking for
- Proven experience running CRM campaigns and understanding CRM principles and channels
- Hands-on experience with a CRM platform (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Oracle, or similar)
- Strong analytical skills-able to turn data into clear, actionable insight
- Confidence producing performance reporting and dashboards (KPIs, trends, outcomes)
- Clear communication and strong stakeholder management

CRM Officer

title: Internal Communications (REMOTE)
description:
Internal Comms and Engagement Officer
- Location: Flexible
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Internal Comms and Engagement Officer to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will connect colleagues to our vision, ensuring accessible information delivery and effective engagement across the organisation. This position offers the opportunity to introduce innovative ideas, challenge existing practices, and creatively enhance internal communications to support our strategic aims.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Lead and manage several of our internal communication channels and engagement forums, including manager communications and colleague forums.
- Gather and share engaging content from across the organisation, enhancing our internal narrative.
- Support the day-to-day delivery of communication and engagement plans, assisting with internal communications for key projects and teams.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation, maintaining high levels of trust and credibility.
- Continuously seek improvements in our communication and engagement strategies, introducing fresh ideas and creative solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience in creating and delivering high-quality, engaging communication campaigns using various channels such as newsletters, intranet, emails, social networks, and digital signage.
- Strong copywriting and editing skills with a keen attention to detail.
- Excellent organisational skills to manage multiple communication projects and meet deadlines.
- Good design skills to create effective content for diverse audiences.
- Exceptional relationship-building skills, capable of establishing trust and developing relationships across all levels.
- Experience with email marketing, editing web content, and using enterprise social networks (Viva Engage desirable).
- Ability to deliver staff engagement activities like events, briefings, or workshops.
- Photo and video editing skills are desirable.

Benefits:
- Competitive annual salary
- 24 days annual leave plus all UK bank holidays
- Excellent pension scheme
- Comprehensive support and training
- Flexible working options
- Additional fantastic benefits
